RockShiny — Quick Guide

Open your Rocksmith 2014 songs (.psarc) and play along on a 3-D note highway, or sing along with karaoke lyrics, with the song’s own audio in sync.

This guide is the short version. Every detail, decision and measurement is in the Implementation Guide.


Play along Sing along
guitar, bass, piano or harmonica lyrics light up syllable by syllable

1. What it does

Feature What you get
Note highway Rocksmith-style 3-D highway for any guitar or bass part, with chords, bends, slides and the other techniques animated.
Other instruments Play the same part on a 3-D piano or a 10-hole harmonica (best harp key chosen for you). MIDI files work too.
Practice Loop any sections with a lead-in countdown, slow down, speed up a little on each pass, lower the difficulty.
Scoring (beta) Play a real guitar into the microphone or a cable; notes light up when you hit them, with a results card and personal bests.
Karaoke Big lyrics, each syllable wiped in colour as it is sung. Only songs that have lyrics are listed.
Offline pages Any karaoke song (or a whole songbook) as one .html file that plays anywhere, no R needed.


2. Run it

1. Install the R packages (once):

renv::install(c("xml2", "openssl")); renv::snapshot()

2. Install the audio tools (once; without them everything works, silently):

Tool macOS Windows / Linux
vgmstream-cli brew install vgmstream release zip from https://vgmstream.org
ffmpeg brew install ffmpeg https://ffmpeg.org

FFmpeg alone cannot read Rocksmith audio (.wem); vgmstream decodes it first.

3. Start the app:

shiny::runApp()

Put your .psarc files in songs/, or drag one onto the sidebar. The first time, the app decodes the library’s audio in the background; after that, songs open instantly.


3. Using the app

Switch between the two modes with the buttons at the top: Instrument | Karaoke. Each has its own sidebar and player; switching pauses the other one.

Instrument mode

  1. Song: pick a song from the library (or drop a file), then an Arrangement (Lead, Rhythm, Bass…) and what to Play on (guitar/bass, piano, harmonica).
  2. Practice: choose From / To sections and switch on Loop this part. Double-click a section in the timeline does the same.
  3. Display, Audio & sync, Scoring and Performance hold the rest.

If the song has lyrics, a Sing along in karaoke mode button appears under the song.

Karaoke mode

  1. Song: the list shows only songs with lyrics. A dropped file without lyrics is refused with a message.
  2. Display: Stage (big lines) or Lyric sheet (the whole song), text size, count-in dots, section names, album-art backdrop.
  3. Audio & sync: Lyrics timing moves the highlight earlier or later; Speed slows the song down without changing its pitch.
  4. Take it with you: Download as HTML saves the song as an offline page.

Click any line to sing from there. Play it in instrument mode switches back with the same song.

Keyboard shortcuts

Key Instrument Karaoke
Space play / pause play / pause
← → ± 5 s ± 5 s
↑ ↓ — previous / next line
Home back to the start (or the loop start) back to the start
L loop on / off —


4. Karaoke pages you can share

Karaoke as a standalone page

One .html file with the lyrics, the album art, the audio and the same player as the app. It opens offline in any browser.

From R:

karaoke_export_html("songs/Dire-Straits_Sultans-of-Swing_v443_m.psarc", "sultans.html")
karaoke_export_html(karaoke_choices("songs"), "songbook.html", audio = "files")   # all songs with lyrics

Without R (Python):

pip install cryptography wem2ogg          # wem2ogg decodes the audio if vgmstream is not installed
python3 tools/karaoke_export_html.py songs/Dire-Straits_Sultans-of-Swing_v443_m.psarc -o sultans.html
python3 tools/karaoke_export_html.py --library songs -o songbook.html --audio files

Both write the same page, byte for byte.

Option (R / Python) Values Use it for
audio / --audio embed (default), files, none one portable file · a big songbook · lyrics only
audio_format / --audio-format auto, mp3, m4a (Python also copy) mp3/m4a for older Safari

A page without audio has a Load audio… button to pair the lyrics with your own copy of the song. Only share pages with embedded audio when you have the rights to the recording.


5. How it works

How RockShiny works
  • R works once per song: it unpacks the .psarc, reads the note charts and lyrics, and sends them to the browser as JSON.
  • Audio is converted in the background and cached, so each song is decoded only once.
  • The browser does everything 60 times a second: drawing the highway or the lyrics, following the audio.
  • Both players share one clock: the audio itself. They correct for the sound card’s delay, so what you see matches what you hear.

Details: Implementation Guide §1 and §4 step by step.

7. Tests

devtools::test()                                  # R tests
python3 tests/frontend/check_karaoke.py           # karaoke in a real browser (Playwright)
python3 tests/frontend/check_frontend.py          # the highway in a real browser
node tests/webr/run_webr.mjs tests/webr/run_tests.R   # R tests without R installed
  • Tests that need a particular song skip when it is not in songs/; they never fail because of it. The skip message names the song.
  • Browser checks need pip install playwright cryptography numpy, playwright install chromium and ffmpeg.
  • Results and method: Implementation Guide §5.


8. Troubleshooting

Symptom Fix
“no audio” in the player install vgmstream-cli and ffmpeg (§2), or point to them: options(rockshiny.vgmstream = "...", rockshiny.ffmpeg = "...")
a song is missing from karaoke it has no lyrics (no vocals track in the .psarc)
the lyrics light up too early or late Audio & sync → Lyrics timing (in the offline page: the − / + buttons)
notes and sound feel out of step on the highway Audio & sync → Fine-tune offset; Safari does not report its audio delay
an offline page plays no sound in Safari export with audio_format = "mp3" (Python: --audio-format mp3)
R CMD check: “files with future time stamps” the files were copied from another machine; touch them (or re-save)
R CMD check: .DS_Store in the check directory created by macOS Finder; delete it, it is not part of the package
